policy: Fixed baseline complete matches at IoU >= .5, same instance identities and manual A centers. Volume/surface errors include all original matches, including degraded matches. Primary distance comparison requires A inside both predictions and refined IoU >= .5; lost points and all candidate distances remain listed. All outliers included. Surface errors sample 256 area-uniform points per surface, seed 42. No signal-network localization or signal-retention selection in this boundary comparison.
